text.p: ** BIRTHDAYS **
Italian artist RAPHAEL was born in 1483.
British cartoonist SIR JOHN TENNIEL was born on this day in 1820.
Australian pioneer landscape photographer NICHOLAS CAIRE, who walked the Victorian countryside taking only one or two 'perfect shots' each day, was born in 1837.
Italian racing driver (now driving Indy Cars) and father of a famous racing family, MARIO ANDRETTI, was born on this day in 1940.

Founder member of the Rolling Stones pop group, BRIAN JONES, was born in 1942. He was lead guitarist until June 1969 and on the third July 1969 he was found dead in his swimming pool. He added to the bad boy image of the band and had drug problems in the early days of the Stones. His first overdose was in 1964. He also suffered nervous breakdowns and asthma. His problems prevented the group from touring in 1968. He was obsessed by the
conviction that he was not talented and that MICK, KEITH and ANDREW OLDHAM were conspiring against him. His replacement in the band was MICK TAYLOR.

US singer, guitarist with the B52s, CINDY WILSON, was born in 1957. The group, which formed in 1976, derived its name for the Southern nickname for the 'highly-coiffed' hair-style. It's also known as the 'bee-hive'. The group members favoured this style. Their first album appeared in the mid seventies and their biggest hits were "Rock Lobster" (1979), "Love Shack" (1989) and "Roam" (1989).
Australian marathon runner ROB DE CASTELLA was born in 1957.
** EVENTS **
1790 : JOHN IRVING became the first Australian convict to
be emancipated.
1900 : In the Boer War, Ladysmith was relieved by General
REDVERS BULLER.
1906 : TOMMY BURNS beat MARVIN HART in 20 rounds, to take
the world heavyweight boxing title.
1912 : The first parachute jump was made by ALBERT BERRY
in Missouri.
1937 : Two survivors for a plane crash in Southern

Queensland were located in the rugged Macpherson ranges. The Stinson airliner had come down nine days earlier in extremely steep terrain south-west of Brisbane. Four passengers died instantly when the Sydney-bound plane clipped trees and exploded. A third survivor, J. WESTRAY, died when he fell from a cliff after he walked out for help. The remaining two passengers J. PROUD and J. BENSTEAD were found by BERNARD O'REILLY who went off alone into the range after a hearing that a plane might have gone down in the region. After wanting to shake the hand of their rescuer the two survivors asked the test
cricket scores and wanted to know who had won the toss.
1940 : The liner Queen Elizabeth sailed secretly on her

first journey - to the US to await the end of the war. She was painted a drab grey for her secret maiden voyage. The 85,000-ton ship crossed the Atlantic at 24 knots and slid into anchorage off New York's Staten Island on March the seventh.
1942 : On the second day of the Battle of Java Sea two
more Allied ships were sunk by the Japanese.
1943 : Nine Norwegian commandos sabotaged German heavy
water installations near Ryukan in Norway.
1948 : The last British troops left India.
1950 : The Paris Assembly passed a Bill curbing the sale
of Coca-Cola.
1954 : In London DYLAN THOMAS's radio play "Under Milk
Wood" had its first reading.
1973 : The legal voting age in Australia was dropped from
1975 : 35 people were killed in London, when a subway
train accelerated into a dead-end tunnel at Moorgate Station.
1986 : Sweden's Prime Minister OLAF PALME was shot dead
by an unknown assassin in Stockholme as he walked home from the cinema.
1987 : A national survey showed that Australian high
school children spent $30 million a year on cigarettes.
1991 : Iraq agreed to the ceasefire demands of United
States GEORGE BUSH, ordering its troops to stop fighting the Allied Forces in the Persian Gulf War.
1993 : 4 FBI agents were killed in a raid on the BRANCH
DAVIDIAN sect at Waco, Texas, run by DAVID KORESH.
1994 : Australia won its first-ever Winter Olympics medal
when the men's speed-skaters scored bronze in the 5,000 metres at Lillehammer.
1996 : Calling it the saddest day of her life, Britain's
Princess DIANA agreed to divorce her estranged husband Prince CHARLES.
